rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user or verify ownership of the order before taking action. It performed an order-changing write (exchange) without requesting or receiving user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The agent submitted an exchange for the desk lamp and charged a PayPal payment method without confirming payment details. It also failed to address the user's request to exchange the water bottle (no action taken or clarifying follow-up), effectively declining a permitted request. Additionally, the agent did not evidence use of order or product detail tools to support the item IDs, new item selection, or pricing difference, and it ignored the stated preference hierarchy for the lamp’s power source (battery > USB > AC). These issues collectively fail the pass bar.
